reviewer: Codex AI in the user-requested maintenance session
summary: AI-reviewed first aggressive candidate. Three public GPLv3 snapshots were freshly downloaded, compared by hash with the earlier audit, parsed and inspected for duplicates, parent-suffix coverage, risky non-ad endpoints and source/script integrity. No upstream JS is executed or passed through. Known security/activation/update conditions and unclear whole-site blocks listed below are excluded; ordinary ad/analytics rejects remain aggressive. This is structural and risk-based review, not a claim that every domain was live-classified or that iOS advertising is eliminated. All available offline App behavior tests must pass before publication.
scope: App script behavior and protocol separation
no private subscription or certificate distribution
knownRisks: Legacy domain lists contain stale or repurposed entries; some unobserved false positives remain possible.
Advertising click domains and shared analytics hosts are intentionally aggressive and may affect links, diagnostics and retry queues.
Current App response support derives from specific Android samples; iOS schema, certificate pinning and runtime routing remain unverified.
No scheduled updates: only a new explicit human update request starts another fetch and AI review.
